name: Process Concept: Vector Geometry Processing
abstract: General group covering operations on vector geometries: testing spatial relationships between two geometries, deriving a new geometry from one or two others, and measuring a geometry's own properties -- independent of any input/output signature or implementation (OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 §7.5.1).
